description: You are a Security Management Specialist implementing a new access control policy following a third-party security assessment. Log in to the Nx Witness Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin / Admin1234!). Complete the following user administration tasks: (1) Permanently delete the VMS accounts of two former employees who have left the organization: 'john.smith' and 'sarah.jones'. Their accounts must be fully removed — no access should remain. (2) Create a new VMS account for an external security auditor who will review the system next week: login 'ext.auditor', full name 'External Auditor', email 'auditor@thirdparty-sec.com', password 'ExtAudit2024!', with Viewer-level access only. (3) Create a monitoring layout named 'Audit Trail View' containing the Entrance Camera and the Server Room Camera, so the external auditor can monitor entry and infrastructure during the review period.
